text: I went to their house once for lunch and there were 12 of us and I couldn't work out for the life of me why I'd been invited.
I was playing Queen Elizabeth and sitting next to her and I thought, well maybe she's seen the movie and wants to ask me about my interpretation.
And I sat next to him and he said, oh hey, you're an actor.
And I said, yeah, that's right.
He said, well I was given a DVD player for Christmas and I can't work out whether I put the green cord or the red cord.
And I said, well, sir, I really stopped my area of expertise.
I thought he's invited me for lunch to tell him how he's making DVDs.
